title: Add ruff + mypy config (0 violations)
prompt:
Add [tool.ruff] (enable E,F,I,UP,B etc.) and [tool.mypy] strict-ish config to the root pyproject. Ensure `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` and `mypy` all pass on the skeleton.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note: Fleshed out the shared lint/type-check gate in the root pyproject.toml. ruff: line-length 100, target py312, lint.select now E,W,F,I,UP,B,SIM,C4,PIE,RET,N (was E,F,I), [tool.ruff.format] with docstring-code-format. mypy: kept strict=true and the PEP 420 namespace settings from 0.3 (namespace_packages, explicit_package_bases, mypy_path, files), and spelled out the strict-ish flags explicitly (disallow_untyped_defs, disallow_incomplete_defs, warn_unused_ignores, warn_redundant_casts, warn_return_any, no_implicit_optional) so a later strict=false cannot silently relax them. TDD: added tests/test_lint_config.py (asserts ruff selects >= {E,F,I,UP,B}, declares a positive line-length, mypy has the strict-ish flags True, and the namespace settings stay True); watched it fail (ruff missing UP/B; mypy missing explicit flags) before editing config, then green.
